findings.current: “I’m already planning to charge out there and fight. Every last one of us who’s still here.”
findings.defect: The draft makes the Skeleton King announce his own plan; he is telling Choi that the others are already prepared to fight.
findings.rationale: 남아 있는 놈들 전부 identifies the people remaining in the shelter as the ones intending to fight, setting up the report that they have grabbed their gear.
findings.replacement: “The others still here are already planning to rush out and fight. Every last one of them.”
findings.source: 이미 당장이라도 뛰쳐나가서 전투할 생각이거든. 남아 있는 놈들 전부.

findings.current: But every radar network—including communications—had been down for some time.
findings.defect: The draft treats communications as a type of radar network.
findings.rationale: 통신을 비롯하여 lists communications alongside the disabled radar networks.
findings.replacement: But communications and every radar network had been down for some time.
findings.source: 통신을 비롯하여 모든 레이더망은 진작 마비된 상황.

findings.current: Just like his thoughts. On and on.
findings.defect: Thoughts substitutes for his emotional state and makes the image less coherent.
findings.rationale: 마음 refers here to his heart or state of mind, not a succession of thoughts.

findings.current: The farther they got from the stretch of corridor they’d just walked through, the stronger the rumbling became.
findings.defect: The draft invents a fixed stretch of corridor they are moving away from; the rumbling has intensified over the distance they have walked.
findings.rationale: The source compares the increased rumbling with the distance the two have traveled.
findings.replacement: The rumbling had grown stronger with every step they’d taken down the corridor.
findings.source: 두 사람이 지나쳐 온 복도의 거리만큼, 울림 역시 강해져 있었다.

summary: One speaker attribution error and three localized fidelity or clarity issues.
